title: D7100

page_data.en:
Copy for O. i/c Special Branch
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 7100

"A"
Central
Misc. No. 556/35.
Nov. 20, 35.

1

Suspected Suicide of S.M. Gontcharoff.

At 12.45 p.m., 20-11-35, a telephone message was received from the Metropole Hotel, reporting that a man was shot in that Hotel.

D.I. Wardrop, D.S. Logan and C.D.C. 44 attended and on arrival were taken to Room 614 situated on the 6th floor of the East side of the hotel, overlooking a waste piece of ground.

Examination of the room revealed deceased dressed in his shoes, trousers, a sweater, shirt, collar and tie, lying on his left side, with his legs outstretched, the right resting on top of the left and both bent forward from the hips at an angle of nearly 45°. Deceased's hands were both extended forward and downward over his stomach. Deceased's head was lying in a pool of blood which extended approximately 3'6" in diameter. A bullet wound was apparent to the top of his right temple and on the left side of his head could be seen a wound which had the appearance of having been caused by the exit of the bullet. A .45 Cal. Colt Auto pistol, 1911 U.S. Army model No 454277 was lying on the floor, beside the back of deceased's knees, with the butt pointing towards deceased's trunk and the muzzle pointing towards his feet. The pistol which showed evidence of having been recently fired was empty. A spent cartridge shell

1935年11月20日。

1

谢尔盖·M·贡恰罗夫（S.M. Gontcharoff）疑似自杀案。

1935年11月20日下午12时45分，接到大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel）电话报告，称该酒店内有一名男子中枪。

警督沃德罗普（Wardrop）、副巡长洛根（Logan）及中央巡捕房第44号警员赶赴现场，抵达后被带至酒店东侧六楼的614房间，该房间俯瞰一片荒地。

经检查房间，发现死者身穿鞋子、长裤、毛衣、衬衫、领子和领带，左侧卧，双腿伸直，右腿搭在左腿上，髋部向前弯曲呈近45度角。死者双手向前向下伸展，置于腹部上方。死者头部躺在一滩直径约3英尺6英寸的血泊中。其右侧太阳穴顶部可见一处枪伤，头部左侧可见一处看似子弹穿出造成的伤口。一支.45口径柯尔特自动手枪（Colt Auto pistol），1911年美国陆军型号，编号454277，躺在死者膝盖后方的地板上，枪柄指向死者躯干，枪口指向其双脚。该手枪有近期射击过的痕迹，弹匣已空。一枚已击发的弹壳

（左侧手写批注：）
S2.
请阅
并转交
登记室归档。
我推测没有理由怀疑
死者卷入政治。
JMC
1935年11月21日

1/Sheet No. 2.

Cal. was however found lying on the floor 6" from the
bathroom door in the North-East corner, distant from the
body about 8 feet, and on top of the dressing table in
the room, a magazine containing 6 rounds of .45 Cal.
ammunition was found. The magazine fitted the pistol
aforesaid. Both pistol and magazine was examined by
D.S.I. Dickson but no finger prints were found. Photo-
graphs of scene were taken by F.P.B. Immediately above
the chest of drawers, about 4'6" from the floor on the
West side of the room, could be seen a hole where the
bullet entered the wall after passing through deceased's
head. The direction of the hole indicated that deceased
either sat or knelt on the floor of the room immediately
in front of the dressing table mirror and in that position
fired the fatal shot. The bullet was extracted from the
wall by D.F.I. Tilton and together with the pistol, spent
cartridge shell, magazine, and 43 rounds of loose
ammunition found in deceased's suitcase in the room, was
forwarded to the Arms Identification Section for examina-
tion. (Further enquiries concerning the pistol will be
made at the U.S.A. Military Authorities).

Dr. W.R. Johnston of the P.H.D. examined the
body at 2.25 p.m. same date, and estimated that death
had taken place several hours previously, also that the
pistol which discharged the fatal shot had been **〔此处转录不清〕**
page_data.zh:
1/页码第2页。

然而是在东北角距离浴室门6英寸的地板上发现的，距离尸体约8英尺，而在房间内的梳妆台顶部，发现一个装有6发.45口径子弹的弹匣。该弹匣与上述手枪配套。副巡督察迪克森（Dickson）检查了手枪和弹匣，但未发现指纹。法医摄影科（F.P.B.）拍摄了现场照片。在房间西侧，距离地板约4英尺6英寸高的五斗橱正上方，可见一个孔洞，系子弹穿过死者头部后射入墙壁所致。孔洞的方向表明，死者当时要么坐在、要么跪在梳妆台镜子前的地板上，并在此位置发射了致命一枪。副巡督察蒂尔顿（Tilton）从墙中取出了子弹，并将其与手枪、已击发的弹壳、弹匣以及在房间内死者手提箱中发现的43发散装子弹一并送往武器鉴定科进行检查。（关于该手枪的进一步查询将向美国军事当局进行）。

公共卫生处（P.H.D.）的约翰斯顿（W.R. Johnston）医生于同日午后2时25分检验了尸体，估计死亡发生在数小时前，并认为发射致命一枪的手枪是在**〔此处转录不清〕**

page_data.en:
1/Sheet No. 3.

at very close range to deceased's head. A search of
the room failed to reveal any document or thing left by
deceased that would indicate the reason for his death.
There is no suspicion of foul play. Enquiries revealed
that deceased, Serge M. Goncharoff (Russian), age 27,
residing with his father and several brothers at 302 Route
Cardinal Mercier, where the former operates a small
chocolate factory, engaged Room 614 of the Metropole
Hotel, on the afternoon of 18-11-35. As far as can be
ascertained deceased was visited in the hotel only by a
Russian named A. Bragin at about 10.30 a.m. 19-11-35, and
by his brother Nick Goncharoff on the afternoon of
19-11-35. Bragin, who was located by P.S. Beloshenko
stated that he visited deceased on 19-11-35, in the
Metropole Hotel at the latter's request when deceased
told him that he was going to the interior to push sales
on his father's products but did not give any indication
of his intention to commit suicide.

At 7.05 p.m. 19-11-35, deceased ordered the Room
Boy No. 12 Huang Woo Li (黃鶴連) 16 Pah Loh Feng,
Broadway, to fetch him some tea and sandwiches. This
the Boy did. At 8.30 p.m. 19-11-35, coolie No. 66 Wang
Ah Tsei (王阿載) 277 Tsing Yang Li, East Yohang Road,
entered the room to remove the tea tray but was told by
deceased not to do so and not to come back till the
page_data.zh:
1/页码第3页。

极近距离对着死者头部射击的。对房间进行搜索，未发现死者留下的任何文件或物品能表明其死亡原因。没有他杀嫌疑。调查显示，死者谢尔盖·M·贡恰罗夫（Serge M. Goncharoff，俄国人），27岁，与其父亲及数名兄弟居住在麦兰神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）302号，其父在那里经营一家小型巧克力工厂，于1935年11月18日下午入住大都会酒店614房间。据查，仅在1935年11月19日上午10时30分左右，一名名叫A·布拉金（A. Bragin）的俄国人，以及1935年11月19日下午其兄弟尼克·贡恰罗夫（Nick Goncharoff）曾到酒店探望死者。由警员别洛申科（Beloshenko）找到的布拉金称，他应死者要求于1935年11月19日在大都会酒店拜访了死者，当时死者告诉他打算去内地推销其父亲的产品，但并未流露任何自杀意图。

1935年11月19日晚上7时05分，死者吩咐12号侍者黄鹤连（Huang Woo Li，地址：百老汇路柏乐坊16号）为其取茶和三明治。侍者照办了。1935年11月19日晚上8时30分，66号苦力王阿载（Wang Ah Tsei，地址：东余杭路清阳里277号）进入房间收拾茶盘，但死者告知其不要收拾，且在次日早晨之前不要再来。

page_data.en:
1/Sheet No. 4.

following morning. The coolie thereupon left the room.
At that time deceased appeared normal. Deceased was not
again seen to leave the hotel.

At 10.30 a.m. 20-11-35, Nick Goncharoff, deceased's
brother, telephoned to the deceased's room but got no
reply. At noon he telephoned again as he was surprised
that deceased did not come home for tiffin as he had
promised to do and on failing to get a reply went to the
Metropole Hotel where on failing to get a reply to his
knock on the door, he then called the hotel reception
clerk Mr. H.G. Athanassiano (Greek) who unlocked the door
of Room 614 with the master key (it should be explained
that the lock, Gibbons, was double locked and that this
can only be done from the inside, so that as it is
impossible to leave the room except by the door, it must
have been double locked by deceased before he committed
suicide) whereupon deceased was found as described above,
and Central Police Station informed.

Deceased's brother Mr. Nick Goncharoff, when
questioned by the undersigned stated that as far as he
knew, deceased had no motive for committing suicide, he
was not known to have any love or financial troubles. It
was learned however that deceased told his brother on
18-11-35, that he intended to fly to Shanghai
with a friend when deceased's brother **〔此处转录不清〕**
page_data.zh:
1/页码第4页。

苦力随即离开房间。当时死者表现正常。此后未再有人见死者离开酒店。

1935年11月20日上午10时30分，死者的兄弟尼克·贡恰罗夫致电死者房间，但无人接听。中午时分他再次致电，因死者未按承诺回家吃午饭而感到惊讶，由于仍无人接听，他便前往大都会酒店。因敲门无人应答，他随后叫来酒店接待员H.G·阿塔纳西阿诺先生（Mr. H.G. Athanassiano，希腊人），后者用万能钥匙打开了614房间的房门（需说明的是，吉本斯（Gibbons）牌门锁被双重锁住，这只能从内部完成，因此既然除了通过房门外无法离开房间，必然是死者在自杀前从内部将门双重锁上），随后发现了如上所述的死者，并通知了中央巡捕房。

死者的兄弟尼克·贡恰罗夫先生在接受本人询问时表示，据他所知，死者没有自杀动机，也未闻其有任何情感或财务纠纷。然而获悉，死者曾于1935年11月18日告诉其兄弟，他打算与一位朋友飞往上海，当时死者的兄弟**〔此处转录不清〕**

page_data.en:
L/Sheet No. 3.

Hirsch (Herman), member of S.M.S. (Specials). The nature
of the business which was taking him to Chengtu was not
communicated to him by deceased, who stated that he
preferred not to divulge particulars of same. Deceased's
brother stated that he believed Hirsch was employed at
Isaacs Motors, 368 Wei Hai Wei Road.

While detectives were enquiring into this case
in Room 614 aforesaid, one who gave his name as Gottlieb,
Tel. No. 43982(Willie's Theatre) telephoned asking for
deceased.

D.S. Beloshenko who interviewed deceased's parents
at 302 R. Cardinal Mercier ascertained that prior to 1930
deceased was employed by Hall & Holtz in Shanghai. In
1930 he was transferred to Tientsin (Hall & Holtz) where
he remained till 1934 (August) when he joined his family
in Japan where he remained till when he went to Harbin
in charge of his father's shop there. In April 1935,
he joined his family in Tsingtao where they had removed
from Japan. Deceased remained in Tsingtao till Oct. 1st
1935, when he came to Shanghai after which he lived with
his family. He was always quiet in his habits and was
not known to be mixed in any shady or political dealings.
His family were not able to throw any light on the origin
of the pistol but opined that he probably acquired it
from some U.S. Naval or Military people with whom he was
page_data.zh:
L/页码第3页。

赫希（赫尔曼）（Hirsch (Herman)），特别巡捕队（S.M.S. (Specials)）成员。死者并未向其透露前往成都的业务性质，死者表示不愿 divulge 具体细节。死者的兄弟表示，他认为赫希受雇于威海卫路368号的艾萨克斯汽车行（Isaacs Motors）。

当侦探在上述614房间调查此案时，一名自称戈特利布（Gottlieb）的人打电话寻找死者，其电话号码为43982（威利剧院（Willie's Theatre））。

副巡长别洛申科在麦兰神父路302号采访了死者的父母，查明死者在1930年之前受雇于上海的霍尔与霍尔茨公司（Hall & Holtz）。1930年他被调往天津（霍尔与霍尔茨公司），在那里工作至1934年8月，随后前往日本与家人团聚，之后前往哈尔滨负责其父在那里的店铺。1935年4月，他在家人从日本迁居青岛后与他们汇合。死者留在青岛直至1935年10月1日，随后来到上海，此后与家人同住。他生活习惯一向安静，未闻参与任何不法或政治交易。其家人无法说明手枪的来源，但认为他可能是从在青岛结识的一些美国海军或军人手中获得的，这些人身份不明。

page_data.en:
1/Sheet No. 6.

acquainted in Tsingtao (identity unknown). When leaving
home on 13-11-35, he stated that he was going to the
interior with Dr. Max Hirsch, but Dr. Hirsch when
interviewed by Mr. Beloshenko stated that he was on
very friendly terms with deceased but had never discussed
with the latter any plans for a journey to the interior,
and expressed the opinion that deceased, knowing that his
family were aware of his friendship with the latter, used
his name in order to persuade them to allow him to leave
home. Dr. Hirsch produced a letter bearing Shanghai
post mark dated 19-11-35, written by deceased on
Metropole Hotel notepaper, copy as follows:-

"Dear Max,

I am very sorry, that I could not get
in touch with you by Telegram. This explains
why I am writing to you these few lines. I am
leaving this town for some time. Before living
I have a big request to you, that is, I would
be very, very much obliged to you if you would
do everything for my brother. I can fully
assure you that he is absolutely honest & de-
pendable man. I am sure that I will not cause
you any trouble by my sudden departure. With
best regards & wishes.

Sincerely yours
Sergi "
page_data.zh:
1/页码第6页。

1935年11月13日离家时，他表示将与马克斯·赫希博士（Dr. Max Hirsch）一同前往内地，但别洛申科先生在采访赫希博士时，赫希表示他与死者关系非常友好，但从未与死者讨论过任何前往内地的计划，并认为死者知道家人知晓他们的友谊，因此借用他的名字来说服家人允许他离家。赫希博士出示了一封带有上海邮戳、日期为1935年11月19日的信件，由死者用大都会酒店信纸书写，副本如下：

“亲爱的马克斯，

很抱歉，我无法通过电报与你取得联系。这也解释了我为何给你写这几行字。我将离开此地一段时间。在离开之前，我有一个重大的请求，即如果你能为我的弟弟做一切事情，我将不胜感激。我可以完全向你保证，他是一个绝对诚实且可靠的人。我相信我的突然离去不会给你造成任何麻烦。致以最好的问候与祝愿。

你真诚的
谢尔盖”

page_data.en:
1/Sheet No. 7.

The following is a list of the effects belonging
to deceased found in Room 614, viz:-
One suitcase containing change of clothing, one
overcoat, one hat, catalogue of Japanese goods, one bag
of "Overland" patent bottle stoppers, 1 cigarette case,
one wallet containing $11.00 in notes, one empty wallet,
one note book with the names C.M. Wong, Chengtu 10-11 and
W.L. Loo 12-1, 15th written therein and particulars of
price of tickets for journey to Chengtu, Hotel expenses,
etc. Slip of paper bearing name of China Travel Service
with certain particulars of times and departures Chengtu-
Chungking-Hankow. One Japanese Certificate of Identity
No. 127 issued 14-3-1931 bearing a German visa dated
14-3-31. One cheque book on The Bank of Chosen and one
cheque book on the Nederlandsch Indische Handelsbank N.V.
While there is nothing to suggest that deceased
was connected with any political party, a copy of this
report has been forwarded to O. i/c Special Branch, and
all seized documents shown to D.S. Cheremshansky.
At 6.30 p.m. 20-11-35, Mr. W. Gottlieb, 10
Larton Terrace, F.C. was interviewed in this Station by
D.S. Beloshanko, when he stated that he knew deceased a
period of 3 years. Mr. Gottlieb who is connected with
China Sound News recently asked deceased if he knew of
any one who might be willing to invest money in his
page_data.zh:
1/页码第7页。

以下是在614房间发现的死者遗物清单：
一只手提箱，内有换洗衣物、一件大衣、一顶帽子、日本商品目录、一袋“Overland”牌专利瓶塞、一个烟盒、一个钱包（内有纸币11.00美元）、一个空钱包、一个笔记本，其中写有C.M. Wong（成都，11月10日）和W.L. Loo（12月1日，15日）的名字，以及前往成都的车票价格、酒店费用等详情。一张印有中国旅行社（China Travel Service）名称的纸条，上面有关于成都-重庆-汉口班次和出发时间的某些详细信息。一份1931年3月14日签发的日本身份证明书，编号127，附有1931年3月14日的德国签证。一本朝鲜银行（The Bank of Chosen）支票簿和一本荷印商业银行（Nederlandsch Indische Handelsbank N.V.）支票簿。
虽然没有任何迹象表明死者与任何政党有关联，但本报告副本已送交特别处负责人，所有扣押文件均已出示给副巡长切雷姆尚斯基（Cheremshansky）。
1935年11月20日下午6时30分，副巡长别洛申科在本巡捕房采访了住在法租界拉顿露台（Larton Terrace）10号的W·戈特利布先生，戈特利布表示他认识死者已有三年。最近，与中国有声新闻社（China Sound News）有关联的戈特利布询问死者是否知道有谁愿意投资他的

page_data.en:
1/Sheet No. 8.

business. Deceased stated that he knew of someone but
refused to divulge his name. On the forenoon of 19-11-35,
Gottlieb called on deceased in the Metropole Hotel by
appointment when they discussed the matter of the loan
but did not arrive at any definite agreement on the matter.
Deceased explained the reason for his living in the hotel
by saying that he had quarrelled with his parents. It
should be mentioned that on 16-11-35, deceased borrowed
$80.00 from his father ostensibly to cover part of the
expenses for his proposed trip. The body of deceased
has been removed to the Public Mortuary pending inquest.
Deceased's brother will identify and claim the body.
Enquiries in the Metropole Hotel failed to locate
any person who heard the report of the pistol being fired.

W Logan
D.S. 265.
D.S. Beloshenko.
C.D.C. 44.

业务。死者表示他知道有人选，但拒绝透露其姓名。1935年11月19日上午，戈特利布按约定在大都会酒店拜访了死者，双方讨论了贷款事宜，但未达成任何明确协议。死者解释其住在酒店的原因是与父母发生了争吵。值得一提的是，1935年11月16日，死者向其父亲借款80.00美元，名义上是用于支付拟议行程的部分费用。死者遗体已移至公立殡仪馆，等待验尸。死者的兄弟将认领遗体。
在大都会酒店的调查未能找到任何听到枪声的人。

W·洛根
副巡长 265号。
副巡长 别洛申科。
中央巡捕房警员 44号。
